assumptions: Experimentally confirmed features (ECO:0000269) show what a true feature looks like to the predictor.
Conformal p-values: confirmed and other features are exchangeable under the null.
limits: A contradiction is a disagreement between two models, to be read, not a correction of UniProt.
von Heijne's matrix and the HMM-TM model are weaker than the predictors behind most annotations.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which signal peptides or transmembrane segments in reviewed human UniProt does a sequence predictor contradict?

description: Find the signal peptides or transmembrane segments in reviewed human UniProt that a sequence predictor contradicts. Each feature backed by experiment (evidence code ECO:0000269) is scored to say what a confirmed feature looks like to the predictor; every other feature, annotated from similarity, sequence analysis or a rule, is ranked among those scores, and its conformal p-value (1 + experimental features scoring at or below it) / (experimental + 1) is corrected across all of them. Signal, by either predictor: von Heijne's weight-matrix score (EMBOSS sigcleave) of the cleavage site UniProt annotates, or DeepSig's probability that the protein carries a signal peptide at all (its eukaryotic network ensemble, from the first 96 residues). Transmembrane: the share of the segment the HMM-TM topology model labels membrane helix. A contradiction is a disagreement between two models, to be read, not a correction of UniProt: von Heijne's matrix and the HMM-TM model are weaker than the SignalP and TMHMM runs behind most such annotations; DeepSig is of their generation. The result carries a self-check, half the experimental features tested against the other half, whose calls are all false by construction.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alpha.description: false discovery rate at which an annotation is called contradicted.

correction.description: Benjamini–Hochberg (independent or positively dependent tests; conformal p-values against one calibration set are positively dependent) or Benjamini–Yekutieli (any dependence; less power). Values: BH (Benjamini–Hochberg), BY (Benjamini–Yekutieli).

decoding.description: transmembrane only: which HMM-TM decoder labels the residues. N-best is left out: it takes minutes per long protein, and the corpus has 5,231. Values: viterbi (Viterbi), posterior-viterbi (Posterior-Viterbi), optimal-accuracy (Optimal accuracy). Only applies when feature is transmembrane. Advanced.

feature.description: which annotation to test: signal peptides or transmembrane segments. Values: signal (Signal peptides), transmembrane (Transmembrane segments).

predictor.description: signal only: von Heijne's matrix asks whether signal peptidase would cut where UniProt says; DeepSig asks whether the protein has a signal peptide at all (it loads 9.8 MB of network weights and runs twenty networks per protein, so it is far slower than the matrix). Values: von-heijne (von Heijne matrix), deepsig (DeepSig). Only applies when feature is signal.

name: discover_annotation_contradictions

contradicted.description: the annotations contradicted at the chosen false discovery rate: accession, gene, span, statistic, p and q

result.description: the full result, every tested annotation included

selfCheck.description: half the experimental features tested against the other half: raw p ≤ α should be near α of them, and FDR calls near none
